intro.text: A noblewoman who leads the gang of thugs hired to protect All's Alley in Urithiru.

items.text: Betha moved from the Shattered Plains to Urithiru after the Everstorm. When Ned killed his wife and then a barmaid from All's Alley, her gang hunted him down and killed him; she had expected him to kill his wife, but acted only when he killed someone they were paid to protect.

Shallan came asking about the murders around the bar. Betha brushed her off until Shallan scratched the Ghostblood symbol into the table, then told her how they had killed Ned, and that the barmaid had died in the same place and the same way as Ned's wife.

appearance.text: She has light brown eyes and wears a havah without a safehand sleeve and a glove cut off at the knuckles.

personality.text: Calm and unfazed by violence, even against people she knows. She recognises the Ghostbloods' symbol and wants nothing to do with them.
